rules: Every media file the app shows is listed here. The app loads media ONLY through this manifest.
Paths are relative to /public. File names must match exactly.
status: placeholder -> generated -> approved. The app shows a placeholder for anything not 'generated' or 'approved'.
Generated media is decorative/atmospheric only. It is never the source of technical truth.

slots.brief: Generic car silhouette in a dark studio, slow orbit, rim light, faint exploded-parts ghosting. No logos.
Abstract blueprint grid with slow drifting light and subtle depth. Sits behind the interactive car diagram, so keep it low-contrast.
Clean, well-lit garage workbench, shallow depth of field, tools laid out, gentle light movement. Background for teardown guide headers.
Quick stylised 'pull-apart' motion of abstract shapes/panels separating. Plays once when a teardown guide starts.
